key_insight: Model order reduction in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces can extend beyond classical rational models through generalized optimality conditions and kernel-based algorithms.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports norm-based reduction of machine learning models and optimized kernel representations for polynomial fitting and PDE approximation.
method: Generalize necessary interpolatory conditions for norm-optimal reduced models to RKHSs.
Construct an alternative to IRKA for differentiable kernels.
Use generalized Malmquist–Takenaka bases and unitary transformations to extend the approach to non-differentiable kernels.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments cover support vector machines, deep ReLU networks, high-degree polynomial fitting, and a FEM-like PDE method, but the abstract reports no quantitative results.
watch_item: Necessary optimality conditions alone do not guarantee globally optimal reduced models; practical convergence and computational costs require evaluation.
paper_title: Norm-optimal model order reduction in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces
